boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Long Branch corridors, each with one directly documented reason to stop.

cards.title: West End Park: playground stop
cards.subtitle: Ocean Avenue North corridor
cards.notes: Use the Ocean Avenue North stop for a daylight playground break; the City lists West End Park at 607 Ocean Ave N with a playground.
cards.short_summary: A named Ocean Avenue North park with a city-listed playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Long Branch lists West End Park at 607 Ocean Ave N and identifies a playground as an amenity.
cards.source_title: Park Information and Amenities | Long Branch, NJ
cards.access_notes: Check the City page for current park information before visiting.

cards.title: Seven Presidents: Skateplex and shore
cards.subtitle: Ocean Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to this Ocean Avenue park to see the Skateplex and the protected dune habitat; follow posted beach and park rules on arrival.
cards.short_summary: An Ocean Avenue county park with a Skateplex and dune habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: Monmouth County identifies Seven Presidents Oceanfront Park at 221 Ocean Avenue and lists its Skateplex and protected dunes.
cards.source_title: Seven Presidents Oceanfront Park | Monmouth County Park System
cards.access_notes: Beach admission and seasonal conditions apply; consult the park page before going.

cards.title: Pier Village: public-event calendar
cards.subtitle: Chelsea Avenue and Long Branch Boardwalk corridor
cards.notes: Check Pier Village’s event calendar before walking the Chelsea Avenue block; its official site identifies ongoing public events and boardwalk access.
cards.short_summary: A named Chelsea Avenue oceanfront destination with public events.
cards.evidence_claim: Pier Village states that it is at 50 Chelsea Avenue, along the Long Branch boardwalk, and has ongoing public events.
cards.access_notes: Individual shops, attractions, and events may have separate costs or access rules.

cards.title: Long Branch Boardwalk: shoreline route
cards.subtitle: Ocean Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Ocean Avenue corridor for a boardwalk walk or run, and observe current beach conditions rather than entering the water without posted guidance.
cards.short_summary: A documented Long Branch coastal corridor for walking or running.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Long Branch identifies the Long Branch boardwalk as the location for its ocean-lifeguard two-mile run test.
cards.access_notes: Boardwalk and beach rules vary by season; check current municipal notices.

cards.title: Great Lawn Stage: scheduled music
cards.subtitle: Ocean Avenue waterfront corridor
cards.notes: Look at the City calendar for a future Thursday by the Sea program, then use the listed Great Lawn Stage location for the event.
cards.short_summary: A named waterfront stage used for the City’s Thursday by the Sea programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Long Branch calendar lists Thursday by the Sea at the Great Lawn Stage.
cards.source_title: Programs & Events Calendar | Long Branch, NJ
cards.access_notes: Confirm the event date, weather plan, and access details in the City calendar.

cards.title: Broadway Band Shell: concert setting
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor
cards.notes: Use the Broadway corridor when a City Tuesday on Broadway listing is scheduled; the calendar names the Broadway Band Shell as its venue.
cards.short_summary: A named Broadway venue used for City concert programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Long Branch calendar lists Tuesday on Broadway at the Broadway Band Shell.
cards.source_title: Programs & Events Calendar | Long Branch, NJ
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current program date and any weather changes with the City calendar.

cards.entity_name: Long Branch Free Public Library Main Library
cards.title: Main Library: study and history
cards.subtitle: Broadway corridor
cards.notes: Bring a project or reading list to the Broadway library; its main branch lists study spaces, computers, Wi-Fi, and a Local History Room.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway Carnegie library with study space, technology, and local-history resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Main Library at 328 Broadway lists Wi-Fi, computers and printing, study and meeting spaces, and a Local History Room.
cards.source_title: Main Library | Long Branch Free Public Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and program calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Elberon Branch: library detour
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take the Lincoln Avenue corridor for a quieter library stop; the Long Branch library identifies the Elberon Branch at 168 Lincoln Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A named Lincoln Avenue branch of Long Branch Free Public Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Long Branch Free Public Library lists its Elberon Branch at 168 Lincoln Avenue in Long Branch.
cards.source_title: Main Library | Long Branch Free Public Library
cards.access_notes: Verify branch hours and services on the library website before making the trip.

cards.title: Manahassett Creek Park: walking path
cards.subtitle: Long Branch Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Long Branch Avenue corridor for the documented walking path, and choose the marked routes and recreation areas that fit your visit.
cards.short_summary: A large Long Branch Avenue recreation park with a walking path.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Manahasset Park at 500 Long Branch Avenue with a walking path, courts, fields, playground, and other recreation amenities.
cards.source_title: Park Information and Amenities | Long Branch, NJ
cards.access_notes: Use posted park rules and check the City recreation page for current conditions.

cards.entity_name: Pleasure Bay Park (Long Branch Community Pool)
cards.title: Pleasure Bay Park: kayak option
cards.subtitle: Atlantic Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow Atlantic Avenue to this City-listed park for its kayaking amenity, and confirm pool or waterfront operations before planning an activity.
cards.short_summary: An Atlantic Avenue park with kayaking listed among its amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Long Branch lists Pleasure Bay Park at 372 Atlantic Avenue and identifies kayaking among its amenities.
cards.source_title: Park Information and Amenities | Long Branch, NJ
cards.access_notes: Pool and water activities may have seasonal rules or fees; verify with City recreation staff.
